_doc: Hand corrections applied by the VIEWER to the built tiles (pipeline/overrides.json is the pipeline's own; fold these into the pipeline on the next full rebuild: docs/TODO.md). Local metres (x east, z south). Every entry needs a 'why' and a 'source'. roadSurface: road id -> OSM-style surface (viewer/roadData.js SURFACE). plazas: paved open areas drawn as their own draped mesh (viewer/plazas.js) instead of the grass default; 'courseDeg' = direction of the stone rows (degrees from +x toward +z).

roadSurface._why: Place de Saint-Job: OSM tags these streets asphalt, they are old granite setts (owner's photos, 2026-11-04: parked cars and the through lane on setts). The tram's Chaussée de Saint-Job stays asphalt (same photos).

plazas.why: Place de Saint-Job between the setts Chaussée (north) and Avenue du Prince de Ligne: one setts square with rows of plane trees and parking; OSM has no area for it, so it fell back to grass.
plazas.source: outline from the tile's roads.json (road centrelines); surface from the owner's photos 2026-11-04

plazas.why: Place de Saint-Job between Avenue du Prince de Ligne and the Place streets in front of the church (kiosk, terraces): setts.
plazas.source: outline from roads.json; surface from the owner's photos 2026-11-04
